props.name: label
props.note: Read by screen readers (aria-label / Semantics label). The placeholder is only a hint.

props.name: value
props.note: React takes the text (controlled) or defaultValue. Flutter takes a TextEditingController.

props.name: defaultValue
props.why: Flutter sets the starting text on the TextEditingController.

props.name: onSubmit
props.note: Web: Enter in a one-line field, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter in a multi-line one.

props.name: maxLines
props.note: More than 1 grows up to that many lines (a textarea on the web).
